content.title: 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' Movie Review and Release: Ranveer Singh starrer garners praise from Allu Arjun, Preity Zinta and other stars
content.text: Dhurandhar: The Revenge Twitter Review Live Update: An X user says the Ranveer Singh starrer is a 'must watch film'Netizens continue to shower love and praise on 'Dhurandhar 2.' Reviewing the movie, one of the X users wrote, "#dhurandhar2 must watch film#adityadhar created a spy world. Every Indian will feel proud of watching this movie, #ranveersingh one man show and #madhavan apt for the roleEvrything sets for the movie, A trainee to hamza, Few supsenses and twists are superb.''Dhurandhar: The Revenge' Review: Fans are calling the movie a blockbusterRanveer Singh and Aditya Dhar are back in theatres, and the fans can't keep calm. After the massive success of 'Dhurandhar,' the duo has hit the big screen with 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge.' Social media has been flooded with rave reviews with fans singing the praises of the movie, actors, director, in short, the overall package. One of the X users took to the platform to write, "#Dhurandhar: The Revenge is ???? BLOCKBUSTER! #RanveerSingh in absolute BEAST MODE—explosive revenge, raw intensity! Epic action, pure patriotism, Ensemble slays, mind-blowing climax! Theatre-shaker—watch NOW! ????????????Jai Hind!"'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' earns USD 1.44 million in North AmericaRanveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' is roaring loud not just in India, but also in North America. According to the trade reports, the earnings from the premiere in North America crossed USD 1 million. The Venky box office reported that with shows spanning across 705 locations, the Aditya Dhar-led film made USD 1.44 million.Meanwhile, its collection from the early previews in India has set a new benchmark. Outperforming Pawan Kalayan's 'OG' (which made around Rs 25 crore in premiere), Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' recorded a business of Rs 44 crore net and Rs 52.71 crore gross in India. Dhurandhar The Revenge Release Live Update: Box office collection - Day 1 - until nowAccording to the Sacnilk report, the film has raked in Rs over Rs 4 crore at the box office on Day 1Dhurandhar The Revenge Review: An X user with the handle @KopanatiVenkat1 shares his opinion about the filmHe posted, "#Dhurandhar2 ???? Wt a fabulous film! Every cast & crew member ????it ????@RanveerOfficial is an absolute beast ????@AdityaDharFilms take a bow for a gripping 4hour experience ????.Watched a truly great film after a long time ❤️. Gt Rdy for Dhurandhar Carnage in Theaters.ATBB loading ????."Dhurandhar The Revenge Release Live Update: Many fans have decided to take a break from social media to keep the film spoiler-free.Dhurandhar The Revenge Release Live Update: Film faces piracy threat; Madras High Court issues strict directive against illegal streamingAccording to the Bar and Bench report, the Madras High Court has passed an order to restrain internet service providers and cable TV operators from streaming or telecasting 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' illegally until April 15.Actor-comedian Tanmay Bhatt praises 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge'Tanmay Bhatt took to his X account and wrote, "Dhurandhar 2. ????????????."Ram Gopal Varma on 'Dhurandhar 2'The filmmaker posted, "All who saw #Dhurandhar2 today told me that they just don’t LOVE #Dhurandhar2 , but they actually want to MARRY #Dhurandhar2."An X handle, @AngoorFan, shared the experience of 'Dhurandhar 2' in the USThe person posted, "Full desi experience in US. March 18 6:30 PM. Dhurandhar 2. Family excited. 9 tickets purchased a week ago. Leaving work early. Early dinner. Arrive at theater. Get stopped. Say print never arrived and they were informed at very short notice. People going in for Hollywood movies. But all desis being stopped. Now in line to get tomorrow's ticket or refund. Never had this experience before. Great going @AdityaDharFilms."As per the Sacnilk report, the paid preview collections of 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' have crossed a staggering Rs 50 crore gross in all versions.Vijay Deverakonda gives 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' a glowing review; calls director Aditya Dhar a 'mad genius'Vijay Deverakonda, the latest celebrity to catch the 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' fever! The star was among the first few celebs who rushed to theatres to catch the early preview show of the highly anticipated Aditya Dhar directorial. Shortly after the screening, the actor took to his handle to share his review of the film and give it his stamp of approval.Taking to his handle, Deverakonda heaped praise in a note that began, "Tomorrow onwards — something big is going to happen in Indian cinema and culture... 4 words. 'Bharat Maata ki JAI!'""Immense love and respect to the entire cast and crew," he said before going on to give a special mention to director Aditya Dhar, calling him "a mad genius." Praising lead star Ranveer Singh for his performance, he best described it as "all in explosive."He also applauded performances by R. Madhavan, Arjun Rampal, Sara Arjun and 'uncle' Jameel Jamali, describing their performances as "superb."Preity Zinta reviews 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge'; calls it 'MINDBLOWING'Actor Preity Zinta caught the first screening of 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' and has only the best things to say about the film, its story, acting, direction and more. In a tweet, the actress gave her review and did not shy away from heaping praise on the team, and urged audiences to also catch a screening."Just watched Dhurandhar 2 & all I wanna say is 'Revenge ho toh Dhurandhar jaisa ho warna na ho' Direction, Acting, music, editing, story, casting & every other department is MINDBLOWING The first thing mom said after watching the movie was that she wanted to see it again in the Theater with her friends & I feel exactly the same," she began her tweet.Showering praise on director Aditya Dhar, she said, "you have turned me into a fan girl & I love it. Thank you for this incredibly immersive experience. Your skill, your talent and most of all your heart is in the right place."Lauding leading man Ranveer Singh for his performance, she declared, "You have my heart. What a stunning performance." She however, did add that she was still struggling for words to commend the actor adding in her post, "What range, what depth, what sincerity I still need to process everything before I can articulate my thoughts."In a special shout out to the cast, comprising of R. Madhavan, Sonam Bajwa, Sanjay Dutt, Sara Arjun and Arjun Rampal, she said, "@ActorMadhavan you know how I felt about your flawless performance earlier & to be honest that goes for the entire cast. @bolbedibol what timing, @duttsanjay what swag, so much sweetness & sincerity Sara Arjun & last but not the least @rampalarjun you have hit it out of the park again."R Madhavan reacts to Allu Arjun’s Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge review: ‘I’m humbled, touched and hyper motivated’Actor Allu Arjun has shared an enthusiastic review of Dhurandhar: The Revenge, applauding the film’s patriotic tone, performances and technical execution.Taking to social media, the Pushpa star described the film as “patriotism with swag,” adding that it is “a film that will make every patriot proud” and features “many clap-trapping moments.” He summed up his reaction with a single word: “BLAST!”Arjun extended his congratulations to the entire team, while singling out R. Madhavan for his performance, along with the rest of the cast. He also commended the film’s technical aspects, calling them “brilliant.”Reacting to Allu Arjun’s praise, Madhavan wrote, “I’m so humbled, touched and hyper motivated. This means so much coming from you, my dear brother.” He further added that he has always admired Allu Arjun’s work. “I have watched all your films with complete awe of your abilities... and so it’s a fantastic feeling to know how mutual it is.”'Dhurandhar 2': Trade experts, exhibitors bet big, hope it breaks recordsWith packed houses for the paid previews, the success of part one still buzzing and its release coinciding with Eid and Gudi Padwa holidays, "Dhurandhar: The Revenge" is set for a bumper opening with industry insiders and trade pundits looking at the Aditya Dhar film setting box office records.The Ranveer Singh-starrer, which comes soon after "Dhurandhar", releases in cinemas on Thursday. And more than 15 lakh tickets have already been sold. This includes the paid previews which begin from 5.30 pm on Wednesday."At PVR INOX, we have not seen this sort of advance booking even pre-COVID-19... The excitement is phenomenal, there’s no precedent. It looks like the film is going to take a massive opening. We are looking at a strong finish to March, and a strong start to April," Kamal Gianchandani, told PTI."I hope it breaks the record of ‘Dhurandhar’ one and hope it turns out to be the first film to cross Rs 1,000 crore nett box office in Hindi, besides, the contribution from dubbed versions of Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam. I hope that’s an addition to Rs 1,000 crore."Fans in Mumbai express disappintment as paid preview shows of 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' gets cancelled at Gaiety Galaxy It was supposed to be a day of excitement and anticipation. Fans had booked their tickets well in advance for the highly-awaited 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' paid preview shows at Galaxy and Gaiety theatres in Mumbai, eagerly waiting to experience the latest blockbuster sequel.However, what was promised as a thrilling show turned into disappointment for moviegoers, as both the 4:45 PM show at Galaxy and the 5:15 PM show at Gaiety were abruptly cancelled.Fans began arriving early, some as early as 4:30 PM, hoping to secure their spots for what was expected to be a packed theatre. Fans opened up about their love for the first 'Dhurandhar' film and their high hopes for the sequel. Many came from far-off places like Andheri, hoping to make it a movie night to remember."I thought the show would start at 6 PM," one fan shared, "but then they told us it was delayed until 9 PM," he added, "But I think it's the team's fault. I will come tomorrow now"Some fans were devastated. "I came all the way from Andheri for this movie," one disappointed moviegoer said. "I thought I would watch it for 4 hours, but now it's all ruined."Many of the fans had been waiting for hours, some standing from 4 pm, and others arriving only to find the theatre packed with people, all of whom shared the same heartbreaking news: the 'Dhurandar 2' show was delayed.R Madhavan reacts to Allu Arjun’s Dhurandhar 2 review— ActorMadhavan (@ActorMadhavan) Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge box office: Ranveer Singh starrer mints Rs 75 crore worldwide, collects Rs 44 crore netDhurandhar 2: The Revenge has made a solid start at the box office, registering strong numbers across domestic and international markets. The Ranveer Singh-led film has grossed Rs 75.00 crore worldwide so far, according to Sacnilk. Out of this, the India gross stands at Rs 52.75 crore, while the overseas markets have contributed Rs 22.25 crore. In terms of net collections, the film has earned Rs 44.00 crore in India.The film’s performance comes from a wide release across 12,292 shows, reflecting its massive scale and reach.Anupam Kher on Dhurandhar success: Credits Aditya Dhar’s honesty, says Ranveer Singh made the film ‘real’Veteran actor Anupam Kher, who recently directed Tanvi: The Great, opened up about the phenomenal success of Dhurandhar and shared his thoughts on what made the film resonate so strongly with audiences.In a recent conversation, the actor spoke about the film’s impact, its performances, and the vision of director Aditya Dhar, calling it one of the finest films in recent times.‘Aditya Dhar was telling a story he completely believed in’Praising the filmmaker’s conviction, Anupam Kher said that the success of Dhurandhar stems from its honesty and clarity of vision.“He (Aditya Dhar) was trying to tell a story which he completely believed in. Aditya Dhar has done a remarkable job. It’s one of the finest films—not because gore or violence was shown differently, but because of the bravado of an Indian agent who goes into enemy territory and the truth of that whole journey,” he told Pinkvilla.‘Ranveer Singh made the film believable’Kher also highlighted the contribution of the ensemble cast but credited Ranveer Singh for grounding the film with his performance.“Bahut saara shrey of course Akshaye ko bhi jaata hai, R. Madhavan ko bhi jaata hai, jitne bhi logon ne usme kaam kiya—mere dost Rakesh Bedi, Arjun Rampal, that young girl Sara Arjun... but I think a lot of credit goes to Ranveer Singh for not breaking the mould of a man who’s standing behind,” he said.Elaborating further, Kher added, “It was his performance which made the film real. He is a superstar—kahin wo flinch karke overreact kar sakta tha, but he stayed calm and composed, and that made other characters look superior.”‘It was Aditya Dhar’s conviction’Summing up his thoughts, the actor reiterated that while every element of the film worked, it was ultimately the director’s belief that shaped its success.“Of course, songs were there, every single thing was fantastic, but it was Aditya Dhar’s conviction which made the film what it became,” he said.Fans react to Dhurandhar 2 paid preview screeningsExcitement was palpable outside cinemas in Delhi on Wednesday as moviegoers shared their reactions to the highly anticipated action drama, 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge.'Fans who attended the paid preview screenings were eager to discuss the film's twists, action sequences, and performances.The sequel to last year's blockbuster 'Dhurandhar,' starring Ranveer Singh, held its paid preview shows on March 18, ahead of its official theatrical release. At PVR Saket, several viewers who emerged after the screening expressed satisfaction with the film, saying it largely lived up to the hype surrounding its launch.One moviegoer described the film as an "entertaining watch" and said it was "really good" and "worth watching." He urged audiences to experience it in theatres, noting that the action sequences and narrative kept him engaged throughout.Another viewer said the sequel had an interesting twist in the second half. According to him, the film keeps audiences guessing until the very end. "I just watched Dhurandhar and it was amazing," he said.A third viewer said the film met expectations and praised its pacing. He also shared that though the film was a bit longer than expected, it lived up to the excitement surrounding it."I just watched Dhurandhar. The movie lives up to the hype. It met expectations. I didn't feel bored at any point," he said.However, not all fans had a smooth experience. Some moviegoers in New Delhi were reportedly disappointed after the 5:00 PM show at Select Citywalk Mall was cancelled.A similar cancellations were reported in Mumbai, where the 4:45 PM show at Galaxy Theatre and the 5:15 PM show at Gaiety Galaxy Cinema did not take place, leaving fans frustrated.Reports also indicated that paid preview screenings in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana were called off just hours before their scheduled start, although no official confirmation has come from the film's makers.Allu Arjun reviews ‘Dhurandhar 2’: ‘A film that will make every patriot proud’— alluarjun (@alluarjun) Shilpa Shetty attends ‘Dhurandhar: The Revenge’ screening with sister Shamita and mother; latter calls the film ‘superb’The Mumbai screening of Dhurandhar: The Revenge saw a steady stream of celebrities, with Shilpa Shetty arriving alongside her sister Shamita Shetty and their mother. The trio made a graceful appearance and posed together for the paparazzi.While exiting the screening, Shamita Shetty briefly interacted with the paparazzi and shared her quick reaction to the film. Calling it “superb,” the actress gave a positive first impression of the much-awaited sequel.Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge first reviews: Ranveer Singh starrer called ‘masterpiece’, ‘box office tsunami’ ahead of releaseThe much-awaited Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge is all set to hit theatres this Thursday, and despite premiere delays and cancellations in some regions, the first reviews are already pouring in—and they are overwhelmingly positive.Starring Ranveer Singh in the lead, the sequel is being hailed as a potential blockbuster, with early reactions suggesting it could be one of Bollywood’s biggest hits in recent times.Trade analyst Taran Adarsh was all praise for the film, calling it a “MASTERPIECE” and rating it 4.5 stars.Film trade analyst Sumit Kadel echoed similar sentiments, describing the film as a “game-changing, industry-shaking phenomenon” and rating it 4.5 stars.Audience reactions on social media have also been largely enthusiastic.Many also predicted that the film could cross the Rs 1000 crore mark at the Indian box office.Preity Zinta and Celina Jaitly arrive for Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge screening in MumbaiThe special screening of Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge in Mumbai turned into a star-studded affair as several celebrities marked their presence. Among those who grabbed attention were Preity Zinta and Celina Jaitly, who arrived at the venue together and happily posed for the paparazzi.Fans Can’t Get Enough of ‘Main Aur Tu’ from Dhurandhar 2Ranveer Singh has dropped a high-energy glimpse of the track Main Aur Tu, and it’s already creating a buzz online. The gritty music video showcases the actor in an intense, action-packed avatar, paired with striking visuals that amplify the song’s edgy vibe. With sharp beats and a catchy rhythm, the track is quickly striking a chord with listeners.The song features vocals by Jasmin Sandlas, Reble, and Shashwat Sachdev, who has also composed the music. The lyrics have been penned by Jasmin and Reble.Fans flooded Ranveer’s post with enthusiastic reactions, praising both the track and the visuals. One user wrote, “We didn’t get over Naal Nachna and then got Main aur Tu!" Another exclaimed, “Damn! Another banger!" while someone else commented, “What a vibe." A fan also shared their excitement, saying, “Catchy number! Can’t wait to hear this in the theatres today."Aditya Dhar apologises for cancelled paid previewsThe makers had planned special paid preview shows a day prior to the action thriller’s release. As March 18 approached and fans headed to theatres, many shows in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana got cancelled due to a technical glitch. Now, Aditya Dhar has apologised to his fans for the same.Taking to his X account, Dhar wrote, “To our dear Dhurandhar family, Dhurandhar is not just a film for us; it is something we have lived with, nurtured, and dreamed of sharing with each and every one of you, together, at the same moment, in every language. Most of our Hindi shows across India are running as scheduled from 5 pm onwards. All of our Tamil and Telugu shows will commence from 9 pm onwards. However, due to unforeseen technical difficulties, our Malayalam and Kannada shows will begin from tomorrow morning."'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Runtime breakdown – 1st half 1:47, 2nd half tops 2 hoursThe excitement for Dhurandhar: The Revenge is mounting with each passing minute. Cinemas across the world are busy loading the film’s content, which is being dispatched at lightning speed to ensure that the first show commences everywhere at 5:00 pm. Meanwhile, exhibition sources have shared an interesting detail about the runtime of the film’s first and second halves.A buzzing report went viral yesterday, spilling details on Dhurandhar: The Revenge's censor trims. It revealed the official runtime from the certificate: 229.06 minutes, which breaks down to 3 hours, 49 minutes, and 6 seconds. According to Bollywood Hungama, the first half of the film is 1 hour and 47 minutes long. As for the second half, it has a runtime of 2 hours and 2 minutes.'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': 21 CBFC cuts revealed; From beheadings to eye-smashing scenes axedRanveer Singh's ‘Dhurandhar 2’ is all set for its big release, but it earned its CBFC A rating after the team made 21 tweaks to the final print. A leaked official list reveals they axed 1 minute and 34 seconds of footage, along with various other changes.Here is a list of all changes made to Dhurandhar: The Revenge before its release: A separate slate stating "This film includes disturbing content, and viewer discretion is strongly recommended" has been added. Likewise, a separate slate for the drug disclaimer, plus a static drug disclaimer for drug visuals, was inserted. Abusive and inappropriate words were muted. Some abusive and inappropriate words were replaced. A name was also changed. Visuals of hitting the head with a hammer, beheading and kicking, hitting the head with cement blocks, and smashing the eye were toned down. All English subtitles were fixed to match the dialogues, and inappropriate text was removed. Subtitle text was added for all songs throughout the film. An official permission letter to the CBFC was submitted for using Prime Minister references and news footage. Hindi text was added for various chapters. Demonetisation dates in subtitles were corrected. The main film title was inserted as per the official application. The word 'Lahore' was replaced with 'Delhi' in the information text. The entire script was corrected to align with visuals, dialogues, lyrics, and suggested changes. End credits length was cut by 1 minute. An Animal Welfare Board of India (AWBI) certificate was provided for animal visuals. 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Aditya Dhar hints at epic post-credits twist, urges no spoilers; ‘Don’t leave your seats until…’Ranveer Singh's ‘Dhurandhar: The Revenge’ comes to theaters on Thursday. Director Aditya Dhar says it has big surprises and twists. He tells people to stay until the end credits for a special post-credit scene. He asks fans not to share spoilers so everyone can enjoy the fun.Aditya Dhar turned to Instagram and X (formerly Twitter) on Wednesday, posting a heartfelt message to his supporters. He highlighted how the whole team poured their hearts into realizing his vision on screen. The caption nailed it: “#DhurandharTheRevenge releases worldwide on 19 March, on Gudi Padwa, Ugadi, and Eid… Oh, and one more thing. Don’t leave your seats until the credits have stopped rolling...dearest, most extraordinary Dhurandhar family.. 5th December 2025, Dhurandhar released in cinemas worldwide. And since then, you didn't just watch our film. You loved it. You lived it. You appreciated every quiet detail, debated every moment, rewatched it and noticed things I never even thought anyone would. Somewhere in that beautiful, unpredictable journey, our film became yours. Then the nations. And then the world's! That is the most humbling, most moving gift a filmmaker can ever receive.”He added, “So when we sat down to make Dhurandhar The Revenge, we knew one thing with absolute certainty: we had to surprise you. We had to make you feel emotions you weren't prepared for. Deeply. Honestly. That is never easy. But for you, we tried our very hardest. We've put our hearts into Dhurandhar The Revenge so you can experience every twist, every emotion, exactly the way it's meant to be felt. In a theatre, in the dark, surrounded by friends, family, and even strangers, everyone feeling the same emotions. That's how films should be experienced. Not on someone's phone in a blurry image. Hence, here is my one, heartfelt, earnest request... PLEASE DON'T SHARE SPOILERS! Let every single fan walk in clueless but curious and walk out with their own deeply personal version of what they felt. You made Dhurandhar what it is. Now I'm trusting you to protect what this becomes”.'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Main Aur Tu's pulsing techno anthem by Jasmine Sandlas and Reble‘Dhurandhar: The Revenge’ is coming soon, and the makers just released the second song, ‘Main Aur Tu’. It's a fun, fast techno song with attitude and a modern beat. Jasmine Sandlas sings it, with cool rap by Reble. Shashwat Sachdev made the music, and Jasmine Sandlas and Reble wrote the words. It mixes feelings with strong beats and a catchy tune.The new track comes after the huge buzz around ‘Aari Aari’, dropped earlier this week and fast turning into a fan hit thanks to its lively energy and retro pop charm. The warm welcome for the first song has fans eager for the full soundtrack from this sequel, heightening excitement for ‘Main Aur Tu’. Released under T-Series, the track's big launch happened on March 17, with Ranveer Singh and others present. 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Memes go viral as fans troll Ranveer Singh sequel's length; 'longer than most marriages'‘Dhurandhar: The Revenge’ storms into theaters worldwide on Thursday, March 19, perfectly timed with Gudi Padwa, Ugadi, and Eid celebrations. The film releases in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam. As excitement builds for this high-octane sequel to Ranveer Singh's ‘Dhurandhar’, the internet is buzzing with memes mocking its epic 3 hours and 49 minutes runtime.Social media fans used their best meme ideas to make funny posts. Let's see them: One said the movie is longer than some marriages. “Dhurandhar 2 runtime is longer than most people's marriages. At least divorce papers don't cost Rs 200 for popcorn #Dhurandhar2,” the user said. Many joked that people need pillows and blankets in the theater. 'Dhurandhar survival' memes got huge with videos of fans calling moms from the cinema to say they're still there. A creator made a funny Instagram Reel about the parking after the movie. It showed staff asking for Rs 400 from viewers, saying even the workers had changed during those long hours.‘Dhurandhar’ fans with night show tickets joined the fun with funny comments. One said: “Booked 11: 15 PM show for Dhurandhar: The Revenge…Will be returning home with doodhwale bhaiya in the morning.” Another joked: “Dhurandhar 2 becomes longest Indian film ever. By the time it ends, kids who entered as minors will need to show adult ID to buy popcorn for the climax.” People online laughed about office workers taking half-day off or fake sick leave to watch the movie.'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Ranveer Singh's epic ‘Dhurandhar 2’ claim: 'The revenge will decide future of Indian cinema'On March 17, Ranveer Singh turned up for the spectacular Mumbai premiere of Dhurandhar: The Revenge's music album. He gushed over the blockbuster buzz surrounding Aditya Dhar's film, admitting the wave of fan love has him reeling. Joining him were co-star Sara Arjun and the soundtrack squad: Shashwat Sachdev, Jasmine Sandlas, Khan Saab, Sudhir Yaduvanshi, and Shahzad Ali.For the first time in public, Ranveer spoke about how audiences reacted to the initial film and thanked them for their backing. Ranveer said, "Doston aapne Dhurandhar ko, humari film ko ek aithihasik mukaam tak pahunchaya hai aur yeh sirf aapke pyaar aur sammaan ki wajah se hai. Aaj pure vishwa ki cinema going audience ko, aap sabko, humari team se dhayanwad (Friends, you have taken Dhurandhar, our film, to a historic milestone, and this has only been possible because of your love and support. Today, we, as a team, thank the cinema-going audience across the world, you all, for this)."He added, "Ab Dhurandhar: The Revenge release hogi jiska na sirf desh mein, pure vishwa mein be besabri se intezar hai. Humari puri team ko iss baat se itni khushi hai (Now, Dhurandhar: The Revenge will be released, and it's being eagerly awaited not just in the country, but across the world. Our entire team is incredibly happy about this). We are so humbled and grateful for the response to the first part of the film. We are so humbled by the kind of excitement and anticipation that we are seeing for the second part. It is unprecedented. We are still processing it. It is such a rush.”Ranveer declared that Dhurandhar: The Revenge would define Indian cinema's future, stating, "Aur itna bata doon, ab Indian cinema ka mustaqbil Dhurandhar: The Revenge tay karega." (And let me tell you this: Dhurandhar: The Revenge will now decide the future of Indian cinema)'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Ranveer Singh hails 'unprecedented' response to 'Dhurandhar 2' music at audio launch event in MumbaiRanveer Singh recently set the stage on fire at the grand audio launch of 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' in Mumbai, expressing deep gratitude for the "unprecedented" anticipation surrounding the sequel.Directed by Aditya Dhar, the spy action thriller is already rewriting history with advance bookings surpassing Rs. 130 crore worldwide. According to India Today, during the high-energy event, Ranveer interacted with fans about their favorite tracks and highlighted the film's massive appeal across international markets. With paid previews starting today, March 18, and a wide release in five languages on March 19, the film featuring a powerhouse cast including Sanjay Dutt, R. Madhavan, and Arjun Rampal is poised to be one of the biggest cinematic events of 2026.'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Ranveer Singh rescues co-star Rajat Arora after on-set injury during the sequel's action sequenceRajat Arora who was injured on the set during an action sequence take remembered Ranveer Singh helped him to the first-aid center.Arora opened up in a conversation with IANS, "Yes, there was an incident during an action scene where I got injured, but I continued performing until the shot was completed. After that, when I fell on the ground, Ranveer Singh came running towards me and picked me up and said "I know it is quite painful, as my wife also went through the same pain, and she also didn't told any one when she was shooting."" "Afterward, he took me to the first aid centre. So there are moments where they teach you resilience."'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Everything to know before the Ranveer Singh starrer hits theatresAs Aditya Dhar’s high-stakes sequel, 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge', prepares for its grand debut on March 19, 2026, fans are revisiting the gritty foundations of the first installment. The saga began with Ajay Sanyal (R. Madhavan) initiating "Operation Dhurandhar," a deep-cover mission born from the scars of the IC-814 hijack and the Parliament attacks.The story follows Jaskirat Singh Rangi (Ranveer Singh), a death-row inmate transformed into the Balochi spy Hamza Ali Mazari. After infiltrating the treacherous Lyari Town and navigating a deadly web involving gang leader Rehman Dakait (Akshaye Khanna), ISI operative Major Iqbal (Arjun Rampal), and local informant Mohammed Aalam (Gaurav Gera), Hamza cemented his position through a strategic marriage to Yalina (Sara Arjun) and a calculated alliance with SP Chaudhary Aslam (Sanjay Dutt).The first chapter concluded with Hamza successfully ambushing Dakait, setting the stage for his rise as "Sher-E-Baloch." The sequel promises to dive into Hamza’s origins while building toward a brutal final confrontation with Major Iqbal.The first chapter concluded with Hamza successfully ambushing Dakait, setting the stage for his rise as "Sher-E-Baloch." The sequel promises to dive into Hamza’s origins while building toward a brutal final confrontation with Major Iqbal.'Dhurandhar: The Revenge': Rapper Rebel opens up on facing racismMusical artist Reble, featured in the Dhurandhar: The Revenge soundtrack, recently shared her reflections on the persistent challenges of racism and discrimination in India. While the rapper noted that she hasn't personally endured extreme instances of bias, she emphasized that the struggles of her peers from the North East continue to affect her deeply.During the chat with NDTV, she said, "I've never faced severe cases of racism, but my NE brothers and sisters definitely have, and it definitely affects me emotionally," she says."I think there's unnecessary hate towards one another in my country, and I hope people unite as one so we can progress. On the bright side, the situation has improved over the years, and I think the youth will take it in the right direction."'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' album out: Shashwat Sachdev composed tracklist revealedThe album of 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' has officially taken center stage following a massive album launch in Mumbai on March 17, 2026.
